title: In Front, Underneath, and On Its Own
label: ch:bn-signs-around-the-letter
canDo: I can read নাম, তুমি and হ্যাঁ off the page, write the two i-bodies and the u-sign, and say what a য hung under another letter does to the vowel beside it.

payoff.summary: Yes — the third word this book ever taught — is read whole from five pieces, four of which the chapter already owned; না is read beside it, and নাম and তুমি are read back to close the chapter.
